title: Graph relation evidence
description: Catalog row for a public ecosystem graph edge. Gideon decision 25 (22 Oct 2026): CTH cohort records are proprietary and may use evidence_type cth_cohort to skip the live verbatim-quote fetch, only when the programme is CTH-run, the row has no personal email, phone, or home address, and any money or pilot outcome has consent_ref.

evidence_type.description: public_quote (default): evidence must be a verbatim quote on source_url. cth_cohort: proprietary CleantechHUB cohort record, exempt from that live fetch when the guardrails in verify_relation_quotes.py pass.

programme.description: Programme id. For cth_cohort, required unless source or target is itself a CTH-run programme listed in cth_run_programmes.json.

consent_ref.description: Consent reference. Required on a cth_cohort row when it records money or a pilot outcome.
